label: Possessives (свой)
description: A 20-question check on the свой possessive lessons.

questions.prompt: What does свой fundamentally point back to?
questions.explain: Свой is the reflexive possessive: it refers back to the subject of the clause and agrees with the possessed noun.

questions.prompt: In «Он взял свою книгу», whose book did he take?
questions.explain: Because the possessor он is the clause subject, свой is used and свою means his own book.

questions.prompt: In «Он взял его книгу», whose book did he take?
questions.explain: Его never refers back to the clause subject, so it marks a different man's book.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: «Она нашла ___ сумку.» — meaning she found HER OWN bag.
questions.explain: Since она is both subject and owner, свой is required; свою agrees with feminine сумку.

questions.prompt: In «Она нашла её сумку», whose bag did she find?
questions.explain: Here the owner differs from the subject она, so её marks a different woman's bag; её cannot point back to the subject the way свой does.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: «Они помыли ___ машину.» — meaning they washed THEIR OWN car.
questions.explain: The owners они are the clause subject, so свой is correct; свою means their own car and agrees with feminine машину.

questions.prompt: In «Они помыли их машину», whose car did they wash?
questions.explain: The possessor is not the subject они, so их refers to some other group's car; свой would have meant their own.

questions.prompt: Why is свою correct, not её, in «Студент сдал свою работу»?
options: Because the subject студент is also the possessor
Because работа is in the accusative
questions.explain: Since студент is both subject and possessor, свой is chosen over его.

questions.prompt: Свой agrees with which noun?
options: The possessed noun, in gender, number and case
questions.explain: Свой declines to match the possessed noun; e.g. своё matches neuter окно in «Я открыл своё окно».

questions.prompt: Which form of свой fills «Я открыл ___ окно»?
questions.explain: Своё is the neuter accusative form, matching the neuter noun окно.

questions.prompt: Which form fills «Мы пригласили ___ друзей» (animate plural accusative)?
questions.explain: Своих is the animate plural accusative form, agreeing with друзей.

questions.prompt: In «Я звоню своему брату», what case and gender is своему?
questions.explain: Своему is the masculine dative form, matching брату.

questions.prompt: Which form fills «Она гордится ___ дочерью» (feminine instrumental)?
questions.explain: Своей is the feminine instrumental form, agreeing with дочерью.

questions.prompt: Which form fills «Я не нашёл ___ паспорта» (masculine genitive under negation)?
questions.explain: Своего is the masculine genitive form, agreeing with паспорта.

questions.prompt: Which form fills «Он доволен ___ результатом» (masculine instrumental)?
questions.explain: Своим is the masculine instrumental form, agreeing with результатом.

questions.prompt: Which form fills «Мы заботимся о ___ детях» (plural prepositional after о)?
questions.explain: Своих is the plural prepositional form after о, agreeing with детях.

questions.prompt: What does the idiom «по-своему» in «Он всё делает по-своему» mean?
questions.explain: По-своему is an adverbial idiom built on свой meaning acting in one's own way, on one's own terms.

questions.prompt: What does «своими руками» in «Я построил дом своими руками» mean?
options: With one's own hands, by oneself
questions.explain: Своими руками is a fixed phrase meaning the work was done personally, with one's own hands.

questions.prompt: What does «в своё время» in «Всё придёт в своё время» mean?
options: In due course, at the right moment
questions.explain: В своё время is a set expression meaning at the right moment, in due course.

questions.prompt: What does the idiom «сам не свой» in «После новостей он был сам не свой» mean?
questions.explain: Сам не свой is a fixed phrase describing being out of sorts or not oneself.
